svg.text: HARROW BAY OFFSHORE WIND – OFFSHORE SUBSTATION HB-OSS – SINGLE LINE DIAGRAM
40 × HTS-12 (480 MW) · 8 × 66 kV array strings · 2 × 300 MVA 66/220 kV transformers · 2 × 220 kV export cables (62 km)
220 kV EXPORT CABLE 1 → Harrow Bay East
220 kV EXPORT CABLE 2 → Harrow Bay East
Notes: 66 kV array cables approx. 95 km total. Each WTG with 12 MW 66 kV step-up transformer in nacelle.
Auxiliary supply, earthing transformers and protection not shown. Ref. WE-ENG-STD-004.
